name: Footprint
description: Your real coverage, measured instead of predicted. Every position packet your radio hears straight from the sender becomes a sample of where you can hear, with its SNR; one that only reaches you through a relay marks a spot where the mesh, not your antenna, carries you. Drawn as a grid coloured by signal, with an outline mode to lay over the predicted coverage. Starts with history when Trails is installed.

retention_days.description: How many days of samples to keep

max_position_error_m.description: Ignore positions a node blurs by more than this (metres). Blurred ones that are kept only show on a grid coarse enough for them: a 1.5 km blur counts on the 1 km grid, not on 250 m.

mesh_only_radius_km.description: How far from your node to draw 'mesh only' cells (km). 0 = automatic: a little past the farthest node you have heard directly.

import_history.description: On first start, build samples from the history MeshPulse already has (stats.db joined with the Trails plugin's positions)

stats_db_path.description: Where MeshPulse keeps stats.db (only read, for the history import)
